lines.en: label tsuneyodorm5:
I knock on Tsuneyo’s door and wait to see if she’s around.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Tsuneyo 的门，等着看她在不在。

lines.en: I doubt that there has ever been another male to visit her at home, so it’s not like I’m going to hold it against her if she doesn’t feel comfortable letting me in.
lines.zh: 我估计从来没有别的男性来她住处拜访过，所以就算她不太愿意让我进去，我也不会怪她。

lines.en: She might be aloof and...strange, but it’s not like she lacks common sense.
lines.zh: 她可能是冷淡了点，也……古怪了点，但也不至于没有常识。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: Who really knows, though?
lines.zh: 不过，谁又真的知道呢？

lines.en: : Who is it?
: Your teacher.
lines.zh: : 你的老师。

lines.en: : Oh. Hello.
lines.zh: : 哦。你好。

lines.en: : Business hours don’t start for another thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 营业时间还有三十分钟才开始。

lines.en: : So you’ll let me in if I wait out here for thirty minutes?
lines.zh: : 那我在外面等三十分钟，你就让我进去？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Wait, what kind of business are you even running in there?
lines.zh: : 等等，你到底在里面经营什么生意？

lines.en: : Ramen.
lines.zh: : 拉面。

lines.en: : You run a ramen shop out of your dorm as well?
lines.zh: : 你在宿舍里也开拉面店？

lines.en: : Dorm?
lines.zh: : 宿舍？

lines.en: : Ah-
It is just then that Tsuneyo seems to realize something.
lines.zh: 就在这时，Tsuneyo 似乎意识到了什么。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m still not used to living here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我还不太习惯住在这里。

lines.en: : How did you confuse a dorm room for a noodle house?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会把宿舍房间和面馆搞混？

lines.en: : Every house is a noodle house if you try hard and believe in yourself.
lines.zh: : 只要你足够努力并且相信自己，任何房子都能是面馆。

lines.en: : You may enter.
lines.zh: : 你可以进来了。

lines.en: scene black
Tsuneyo pulls the door open from the inside and I wander into the room, nodding at her as I do so.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 从里面把门拉开，我走进房间，边走边朝她点点头。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm1
if mollydorm5 == False:
The place is...more or less what I expect it to be. Filled with various [teenage]girl things and...
lines.zh: 这地方……大体跟我预想的一样。摆满了各种[teenage]女孩的玩意儿，还有……

lines.en: And a giant portrait of Tsuneyo’s favorite food.
lines.zh: 还有一幅 Tsuneyo 最爱的食物的巨型画像。

lines.en: else:
It feels a little different being in here to see Tsuneyo instead of Molly.
lines.zh: 在这里见的是 Tsuneyo 而不是 Molly，感觉有点不一样。

lines.en: And that’s not saying I don’t like her or anything. I obviously do since I came to visit her. She’s just...you know.
lines.zh: 这并不是说我不喜欢她什么的。我既然来看她，显然是喜欢的。她只是……你知道的。

lines.en: But at least this finally gives me a chance to ask about the giant portrait of ramen on the wall.
lines.zh: 但至少，这终于让我有机会问问墙上那幅巨大的拉面画像了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm2
: I apologize for forgetting where I was. That happens sometimes.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我忘了自己身在何处。这种事偶尔会发生。

lines.en: : That’s not a good thing to happen on a persistent basis.
lines.zh: : 这种事要是经常发生可不太好。

lines.en: : There are worse habits.
lines.zh: : 还有更糟的习惯呢。

lines.en: : Like drug use. Or jump-rope.
lines.zh: : 比如吸毒。或者跳绳。

lines.en: : I’m struggling to see how exactly jump-rope is a bad habit...but you do you, Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : 我实在看不出跳绳怎么就成了坏习惯……不过你开心就好，Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : Then you have not jumped enough ropes in your life.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你这一生跳绳跳得还不够多。

lines.en: : I suppose I have not.
lines.zh: : 我想是没有。

lines.en: : Would you like a tour of the room? There are no ropes involved.
lines.zh: : 你想参观一下房间吗？全程不会用到绳子。

lines.en: : None? Damn. There go my plans.
lines.zh: : 一根都没有？真扫兴。我的计划泡汤了。

lines.en: : I do not understand.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。

lines.en: : Figures. You can show me around if you’d like. I can't imagine it will take very long.
lines.zh: : 意料之中。你愿意的话就带我转转吧。我想也花不了多长时间。

lines.en: : I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Please follow me.
lines.zh: : 请跟我来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm3
Tsuneyo leads me over to her bed and immediately begins the “tour.”
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 把我领到她的床边，立刻开始了这场“参观”。

lines.en: : This is where I sleep.
lines.zh: : 这是我睡觉的地方。

lines.en: : You will notice several llamas on the shelf above my bed.
lines.zh: : 你会注意到我床上方的架子上有几只羊驼。

lines.en: : There is a simple reason for this.
lines.zh: : 这有个很简单的原因。

lines.en: : Is the reason that you like llamas?
lines.zh: : 原因是你喜欢羊驼？

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 正确。

lines.en: : Who could have possibly seen that coming?
lines.zh: : 谁能料得到呢？

lines.en: : Your sarcasm irritates me.
lines.zh: : 你的讽刺让我恼火。

lines.en: : You’ll get used to it.
lines.zh: : 你会习惯的。

lines.en: : I hope not.
lines.zh: : 我希望不会。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm4
: To the right of the llamas, you may have noticed a large bowl of ramen.
lines.zh: : 在羊驼的右边，你可能已经注意到有一大碗拉面。

lines.en: : This is because-
lines.zh: : 这是因为——

lines.en: : You like ramen?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢拉面？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm3
: You are ruining the tour.
lines.zh: : 你在毁掉这次参观。

lines.en: : Sorry. Even with your love for noodles, though, I'm surprised that portrait is...as big as it is.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。不过就算你再怎么喜欢面条，我还是挺惊讶那幅画竟然……这么大。

lines.en: : It’s probably even more eye-catching than all of Molly's figures and some of them aren't even fully clothed.
lines.zh: : 它可能比 Molly 所有的手办还抢眼，而那些手办有的甚至没穿整齐。

lines.en: : Thanks, bro.
lines.zh: : 谢了，老兄。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm4
: The most interesting part of this particular bowl of ramen is that it was not made by me.
lines.zh: : 这碗拉面最耐人寻味的地方在于，它不是我做的。

lines.en: : Who was it made by, then?
lines.zh: : 那它是谁做的？

lines.en: : I do not know. It simply arrived here one day and I did what any rational woman would do and hung it up directly beside my bed.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。某天它就那么出现在这里，然后我做了一个理性女人都会做的事——把它直接挂在床边。

lines.en: : Yup. Seems rational enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯。看起来是够理性的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm3
: I have never lived with another [teenage]girl before, but I understand that we are supposed to cover the wall in things we like.
lines.zh: : 我以前从没和别的[teenage]女孩一起住过，但我知道我们应该在墙上贴满自己喜欢的东西。

lines.en: : And I could not get actual noodles to hang properly.
lines.zh: : 而且真正的面条我没法好好挂上去。

lines.en: : Please tell me that was a joke.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我那是句玩笑话。

lines.en: : That was a joke.
lines.zh: : 那是句玩笑话。

lines.en: Hey, I finally caught one. Maybe I’m beginning to understand Tsuneyo after all?
lines.zh: 嘿，我总算接住了一个。也许我开始有点懂 Tsuneyo 了？

lines.en: : Here’s the thing, though, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm5
: Ah-
: Normally, [teenage]girls will hang up posters of...their favorite bands or TV shows. Or in Molly’s case, a bunch of weird stuff.
lines.zh: : 一般来说，[teenage]女孩会贴……自己喜欢的乐队或电视剧的海报。或者像 Molly 那样，贴一堆稀奇古怪的东西。

lines.en: : Is liking noodles strange?
lines.zh: : 喜欢面条很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Liking them as much as {i}you{/i} do is strange. It’s time to develop new hobbies.
lines.zh: : 喜欢到{i}你{/i}这种程度就很奇怪了。是时候培养点新爱好了。

lines.en: : Hobbies?
lines.zh: : 爱好？

lines.en: : Yeah. Like, didn’t you say you did Kendo when you were younger? How about hanging up...Kendo stuff?
lines.zh: : 对啊。比如，你不是说你小时候练过剑道吗？挂点……剑道相关的东西怎么样？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm3
: Oh. Please allow me to use that topic for what people in show business call a “segue.”
lines.zh: : 哦。请允许我借这个话题做一个演艺圈人士所谓的“转场”。

lines.en: : Follow me, please.
lines.zh: : 请跟我来。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm6
Tsuneyo quickly moves past me before turning around and mirroring her pose from the first section of the tour.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 快步从我身边走过，然后转过身来，摆出和参观第一段时一模一样的姿势。

lines.en: : Welcome to the more interesting side of Tsuneyo Tojo.
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到 Tsuneyo Tojo 更有意思的一面。

lines.en: : I don’t think stacking a few bamboo swords in the corner really qualifies as interesting. It's barely even a hobby if you don't use them.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得在角落里堆几把竹剑就能算有意思。你都不用它们，那连爱好都算不上。

lines.en: : Would you prefer I attacked you with them?
lines.zh: : 你更希望我用它们攻击你吗？

lines.en: : That was a joke too, right?
lines.zh: : 那也是玩笑话，对吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm7
: The hesitation right there did not make me feel comfortable.
lines.zh: : 那一下的犹豫让我很不舒服。

lines.en: If Tsuneyo actually {i}did{/i} attack me, it’s not like I wouldn’t be able to defend myself, right?
lines.zh: 就算 Tsuneyo {i}真{/i}来攻击我，我也不至于没法自卫吧？

lines.en: I mean, she can’t be that good at Kendo, can she?
lines.zh: 我是说，她的剑道不可能那么厉害吧？

lines.en: : I would have liked watching you do all that sword stuff whenever you were into that, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，我真想看看你当年迷剑道时挥剑的样子。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm6
: Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 真的？为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Just feel like it would be kind of cool to see you...actually doing something.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。就是觉得……看你真的在做点什么，应该挺酷的。

lines.en: : I doubt it was anything intense, but still-
lines.zh: : 我想也不会有多激烈，不过——

lines.en: : I was the national junior Kendo champion three years in a row.
lines.zh: : 我连续三年是全国少年剑道冠军。

lines.en: : It was the only thing I ever left home for.
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一一次为某件事离开家。

lines.en: : Wait...national? As in the entire nation?
lines.zh: : 等等……全国？就是整个国家的那种全国？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm7
: Does that word have another meaning I am unaware of?
lines.zh: : 这个词还有我不知道的其他意思吗？

lines.en: : If...you won the national championship three years in a row, why did you stop?
lines.zh: : 如果……你连续三年拿了全国冠军，为什么停下来了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm6
: To take care of my father and carry on the family’s legacy.
lines.zh: : 为了照顾我父亲，继承家业。

lines.en: : The noodle legacy?
lines.zh: : 面条家业？

lines.en: : The noodle legacy.
lines.zh: : 面条家业。

lines.en: : You gave up an amazing talent for that?
lines.zh: : 你就为了这个放弃了那么了不起的才能？

lines.en: : There is no talent more amazing than making soup.
lines.zh: : 没有什么才能比煮汤更了不起。

lines.en: : Not having to train gives me more free time, though. I can do anything I want now.
lines.zh: : 不过不用训练，我就有更多空闲时间了。现在我想做什么就做什么。

lines.en: : I am essentially a soup god.
lines.zh: : 我基本上就是汤之神。

lines.en: : Weren’t we literally just talking about how you need hobbies apart from your job, though?
lines.zh: : 可我们刚刚不还在说，除了工作你还得有点爱好吗？

lines.en: : That was a topic you brought up without my participation. Do not lump me in with the likes of you, damn it.
lines.zh: : 那是你单方面提出的话题，我没参与。别把我跟你这种人混为一谈，可恶。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm8
: Now that I am a normal [high_school] girl, I am free to make my own decisions and choose my own hobbies.
lines.zh: : 既然我现在是个普通的[high_school]女孩，我就可以自己做决定、自己选爱好了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, the Emerald Guardian has recently informed me of a wonderful sounding game where you can kill people and not be prosecuted for it.
lines.zh: : 幸好，翡翠守护者最近告诉我一个听起来很棒的游戏，在里面你可以杀人而且不会被追究。

lines.en: : This is the path that I will walk congruently alongside noodles.
lines.zh: : 这条道路我会和面条并驾齐驱地走下去。

lines.en: : What, like a...video game or something?
lines.zh: : 什么，像是……电子游戏之类的？

lines.en: : There is no video involved. It is called Dungeons & Dragons.
lines.zh: : 没有电子成分。它叫 Dungeons & Dragons。

lines.en: : She says she is going to teach me.
lines.zh: : 她说她要教我。

lines.en: : If that goes well, I may replace my ramen portrait with a creature that I have always known is fake. The dragon.
lines.zh: : 如果进展顺利，我可能会把拉面画像换成一种我一直知道是假的生物。龙。

lines.en: : Don’t try and trick me into forgetting what you said at the ramen shop, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 别想蒙我，让我忘了你在拉面店说的话，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm9
: Ah-
: Still, though...it’s good that you and Molly seem to be getting along.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……你和 Molly 看起来相处得不错，这很好。

lines.en: : You’re kind of polar opposites, so I wasn’t sure how that would work out.
lines.zh: : 你们俩算是两个极端，我本来还不确定会怎么样。

lines.en: : I imagine it is due to my lack of personality.
lines.zh: : 我想是因为我没有个性吧。

lines.en: : Hey now, there’s no need to put yourself down about it.
lines.zh: : 哎，别这么说自己。

lines.en: : What you lack in personality, you make up for in the desire to improve.
lines.zh: : 你在个性上的欠缺，用想要进步的上进心补上了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm10
Well, looks like her little put-down right there was supposed to be a joke as well.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来她刚才那句自贬也是个玩笑。

lines.en: But hey, least I was able to catch one today.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，至少我今天接住了一个。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian was right...
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者说得对……

lines.en: : I am a “normie” after all.
lines.zh: : 我果然是个“正常人”。

lines.en: : A what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It means normal person. I think.
lines.zh: : 意思是正常人。大概吧。

lines.en: : I was under the impression being normal was the right thing to do, but she makes it sound like I am evil.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为做个正常人是正确的，可她说的听起来我像是邪恶的。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is time for me to move back home. I am not prepared for this world.
lines.zh: : 也许我该搬回家了。我还没准备好面对这个世界。

lines.en: : You can’t move out yet. What will happen to Noodles?
lines.zh: : 你现在还不能搬走。Noodles 怎么办？

lines.en: : That’s exactly why I have to go home. The noodles need me.
lines.zh: : 这正是我必须回家的原因。面条需要我。

lines.en: : No, no. I mean Noodles the bird. The one that we named.
lines.zh: : 不，不。我是说那只鸟 Noodles。我们给它起名字的那只。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm11
: Oh! {i}Noodles!{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦！{i}Noodles{/i}！

lines.en: : Yes. Noodles would be quite lonely without me.
lines.zh: : 是的。没有我，Noodles 会相当寂寞。

lines.en: : Your [niece] with the soft legs keeps trying to “rescue” him, but I wish she would stop.
lines.zh: : 你那个腿软的[niece]老是想“救”他，我真希望她别再这样了。

lines.en: : He is well-fed. I have been making sure of it.
lines.zh: : 他吃得很好。我一直有在确保这一点。

lines.en: : Well, at least I don’t need to take a guess about what you’re feeding him.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少我不用猜你喂他什么了。

lines.en: : That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Can birds really survive off of just n-
lines.zh: : 鸟真的只靠面——

lines.en: : Bird seed.
lines.zh: : 鸟食。

lines.en: : My father taught me about the right things to feed birds when I was still a little girl.
lines.zh: : 我还是个小女孩的时候，父亲就教过我该给鸟喂什么。

lines.en: That's...actually kind of cute.
lines.zh: 这……其实还挺可爱的。

lines.en: I guess Tsuneyo’s relationship with her father is one of those more loving and sentimental ones?
lines.zh: 看来 Tsuneyo 和她父亲的关系属于那种比较有爱、比较温情的？

lines.en: Is she really okay spending so much time here when he’s so sick?
lines.zh: 他病得这么重，她真的放心在这里待这么久吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm12
: I remember it vividly.
lines.zh: : 我记得清清楚楚。

lines.en: : We would wake up early every morning and head to the backyard to feed the chickens.
lines.zh: : 我们每天天不亮就起床，去后院喂鸡。

lines.en: : It was almost as if they were part of the family.
lines.zh: : 它们几乎就像是家里的一分子。

lines.en: : And then, once they were fully grown, we would snap their necks and pluck their bodies clean of feathers for use in our food.
lines.zh: : 然后，等它们长大，我们就拧断它们的脖子，把毛拔干净，用来做菜。

lines.en: Okay, never mind. I’m sure her father will be fine alone.
lines.zh: 好吧，当我没说。我相信她父亲一个人也没问题。

lines.en: : You...were trained to kill chickens as a little girl?
lines.zh: : 你……小时候被训练杀鸡？

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm13
: I was trained to kill many things as a little girl.
lines.zh: : 我小时候被训练杀很多东西。

lines.en: : My father is incredibly protective.
lines.zh: : 我父亲的保护欲强得离谱。

lines.en: : If he knew I was alone in a room with a man, he would have you executed.
lines.zh: : 如果他知道我和一个男人单独待在一个房间里，他会处死你。

lines.en: : You’re not going to tell him about this, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会告诉他这件事的，对吧？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 我会。

lines.en: : But...you just said that he’d have me executed.
lines.zh: : 可是……你刚说他会处死我。

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Are you...trying to have me killed?
lines.zh: : 你……是想害死我吗？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm9
: Ah-
: I’m not ready to die yet. You can’t tell your father about this.
lines.zh: : 我还不想死。你不能把这件事告诉你父亲。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm13
: That would be breaking the rules, though.
lines.zh: : 可那样就违反规矩了。

lines.en: : It’s okay to break rules every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 偶尔破个规矩也没什么。

lines.en: : But if I break the rules, all of my teeth will turn to liquid.
lines.zh: : 但如果我破了规矩，我所有的牙齿都会化成液体。

lines.en: : What the fuck has your father been teaching you?
lines.zh: : 你父亲到底都教了你些什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : That my teeth will turn to liquid if I break the rules. Please pay attention.
lines.zh: : 说我如果破了规矩，牙齿就会化成液体。请专心听。

lines.en: : Just...please don’t tell him. Okay? I promise to keep spending money at the restaurant as long as he doesn’t know that I visit you here.
lines.zh: : 就……请别告诉他。好吗？我保证会继续在店里花钱，只要他不知道我来这里看你。

lines.en: : How much money?
lines.zh: : 多少钱？

lines.en: : Does it matter?
lines.zh: : 这重要吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 重要。

lines.en: : This is starting to sound like extortion.
lines.zh: : 这听着越来越像敲诈了。

lines.en: : It is, more or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多就是。

lines.en: : I’ll spend...a good amount of money. I promise.
lines.zh: : 我会花……一笔不少的钱。我保证。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : But I am not doing it for you.
lines.zh: : 但我不是为了你才这么做的。

lines.en: : I’m doing it for Noodles.
lines.zh: : 我是为了 Noodles。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm14
: You participated in naming him, so I don’t think he’d be happy if you were to suddenly vanish.
lines.zh: : 你也参与了给他起名字，所以我觉得如果你突然消失，他不会开心的。

lines.en: : I think it’s safe to say there would be a lot of unhappy people if I were to suddenly vanish.
lines.zh: : 我想可以肯定地说，如果我突然消失，会有很多人不开心的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyofirstdorm13
: I wouldn’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我不会介意。

lines.en: : Thanks, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: scene black
I decide against asking her if that last one was a joke or not since I’m mildly afraid of the answer I’d receive.
lines.zh: 我决定不问她最后那句是不是玩笑，因为我有点怕听到答案。

lines.en: But, at the end of the day, I was able to spend some more time alone with her.
lines.zh: 但归根结底，我还是和她单独多待了一会儿。

lines.en: And even if she threatened to kill me and admitted to murdering animals, I feel like the two of us managed to grow closer...
lines.zh: 而且就算她威胁要杀我、还承认杀过动物，我还是觉得我们俩的关系近了一步……
